sampling_frame_contract.future_required_review: fresh non-author sampling and leakage review before any Stage C pixel generation
sampling_frame_contract.registry_freeze_time: before model output, intervention effect or reference loss is inspected
sampling_frame_contract.selection_algorithm: sort eligible registry records by SHA256(ASCII('RAIMA_V4_FRAME_SELECTION_440031|') || canonical_registry_record_sha256_bytes) and take the first 20
sampling_frame_contract.replacement_policy: no replacement after selection; failure remains in flow and blocks evaluability
sampling_frame_contract.independence_rule: all 20 independence_cluster_id values must be unique
sampling_frame_contract.independence_cluster_definition: same physical room or overlapping outdoor zone, shared target/reference capture session, or reused generated-history state belongs to one cluster
sampling_frame_contract.assumption_boundary: population-level binomial interpretation requires independent exchangeable scene draws; if the frozen frame cannot justify this, report only roster-specific rates

per_scene_contract.trajectory_order: short then long in acquisition; analysis reorders by registered ID
per_scene_contract.return_short: depart from the registered anchor, traverse one occluding turn or view loss, then return to the registered anchor checkpoint
per_scene_contract.return_long: depart from the same anchor, traverse at least twice the short-route path length and at least two distinct view losses, then return to the registered anchor checkpoint
per_scene_contract.path_freeze: camera/action waypoints, anchor target checkpoint and tolerances are fixed before ordinary generation
per_scene_contract.technical_repeat_rule: five seeds are paired repeats and never independent scientific units
per_scene_contract.primary_target: the predeclared final anchor-return target checkpoint
per_scene_contract.primary_source_selector: ordinary selector rank 1 at that checkpoint; tie break by registered selector rank then lexicographic stable source_id
per_scene_contract.selector_information_boundary: only ordinary trace metadata may be read; generated pixels, reference pixels, endpoint values and losses remain blinded
per_scene_contract.source_failure_rule: if rank-1 source lacks stable identity or complete Address evidence, record FAIL/MISSING and do not substitute rank 2
per_scene_contract.secondary_sources: all additional selected sources remain in the flow but are descriptive and cannot enter the V4 primary endpoint

missingness_and_attrition.primary_rule: every planned slot stays in flow; any non-complete primary unit makes its scene and cohort fail closed
